verdict.rationale: PayPal's webhooks deliver event notifications (e.g., dispute created, payment captured) with durable retry and signature verification, which a merchant could wire into custom logic, but there is no evidence of a built-in rules/automation engine where an AI-native user directly defines 'on event X do action Y' logic within the product itself — that would have to be built externally using webhooks plus agent-toolkit functions. missing for 10: a native rule-definition UI/API, conditional trigger logic, or documented automation workflows beyond raw webhook delivery.
